entries.title: Proverbs 8:1
segments: ¶Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?

entries.title: Proverbs 8:2
segments: She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:3
segments: She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:4
segments: Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice [is] to the sons of man.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:5
segments: O ye simple, understand wisdom: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:6
segments: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips [shall be] right things.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:7
segments: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness [is] an abomination to my lips. {an...: Heb. the abomination of my lips}

words.text: . {an...: Heb. the abomination of my lips}

entries.title: Proverbs 8:8
segments: All the words of my mouth [are] in righteousness; [there is] nothing froward or perverse in them. {froward: Heb. wreathed}

entries.title: Proverbs 8:9
segments: They [are] all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:10
segments: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:11
segments: For wisdom [is] better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.

words.text: ; and all the things that may be desired

entries.title: Proverbs 8:12
segments: ¶I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions. {prudence: or, subtilty}

entries.title: Proverbs 8:13
segments: The fear of the LORD [is] to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:14
segments: Counsel [is] mine, and sound wisdom: I [am] understanding; I have strength.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:15
segments: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:16
segments: By me princes rule, and nobles, [even] all the judges of the earth.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:17
segments: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.

words.text: me; and those that seek me early

entries.title: Proverbs 8:18
segments: Riches and honour [are] with me; [yea], durable riches and righteousness.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:19
segments: My fruit [is] better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:20
segments: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment: {lead: or, walk}

entries.title: Proverbs 8:21
segments: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.

words.text: That I may cause those that love

entries.title: Proverbs 8:22
segments: ¶The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:23
segments: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:24
segments: When [there were] no depths, I was brought forth; when [there were] no fountains abounding with water.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:25
segments: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:

entries.title: Proverbs 8:26
segments: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world. {fields: or, open places} {the highest...: or, the chief part}

words.text: While as yet he had not made
. {fields: or, open places} {the highest...: or, the chief part}

entries.title: Proverbs 8:27
segments: When he prepared the heavens, I [was] there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth: {a compass: or, a circle}

entries.title: Proverbs 8:28
segments: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:

entries.title: Proverbs 8:29
segments: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:

entries.title: Proverbs 8:30
segments: Then I was by him, [as] one brought up [with him]: and I was daily [his] delight, rejoicing always before him;

entries.title: Proverbs 8:31
segments: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights [were] with the sons of men.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:32
segments: ¶Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed [are they that] keep my ways.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:33
segments: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:34
segments: Blessed [is] the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.

entries.title: Proverbs 8:35
segments: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the LORD. {obtain: Heb. bring forth}

entries.title: Proverbs 8:36
segments: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.
